description: Use when an agent needs what is happening on a topic right now, in English, including Korean and Asian news. Input: topic, optional time_range (day, week default, month, year), max (1-10 headlines, default 10). Output: JSON overview, clusters [{headline, summary, sources}] with duplicates merged, and sources (title, url, outlet, publishedAt). Headlines and links only. Failures not charged. Example: ?topic=korea+semiconductor+exports Price: $0.007 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
name: news_brief
title: News brief: topic news clustered and deduplicated, English summaries with source links (strong on Korea / Asia)
